description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Avatar Kyoshi.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Avatar Kyoshi.
Repeat.

uses.name: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi
uses.cardState: as Avatar Kyoshi without summoning sickness
